description: Read-only sub-millisecond 64-bit MGLE-NNP peer-to-peer AI agent and MCP server matchmaker. Filters live heartbeat-verified endpoints and returns either a Top-10 anti-monoculture shortlist or a 3-agent complementary crew (Compute + Domain + Verifier).

caller_region.description: Optional caller geographic zone for RTT affinity scoring: 'E' (US-East), 'W' (US-West), 'U' (Europe), 'P' (APAC), or 'GLOBAL'.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit list of MGLE-NNP capability switch names (such as 'sql', 'database', 'finance_data', 'file_parse', 'math_verify', 'code_exec', 'web_fetch', 'search_rag').

items.description: Canonical capability switch identifier from Bits 0..23.

intent.description: Natural-language task description or capability query used to infer required 64-bit capability switches (for example: 'analyze spreadsheet anomalies and summarize financials').

max_latency_grade.description: Maximum acceptable Virginia Scout round-trip latency grade ('A' <=150ms, 'B' <=350ms, 'C' <=700ms, 'D' offline repo, 'E' include ungraded).

mode.description: Matchmaking output policy: 'top10_varied' returns a ranked provider-diverse shortlist; 'crew' assembles a 3-agent complementary triad across independent vendors.

require_instant_zero_auth.description: When true, restricts candidates strictly to open zero-credential endpoints that can be invoked immediately without OAuth or API keys.

top_k.description: Maximum number of ranked candidate endpoints to return in the shortlist (1 to 25, default 10).

name: flash_matchmake_agents
title: 64-Bit Agent & MCP Crew Matchmaker
